Ray Conniff
and His Orchestra. It was released in 1958 on the
Columbia
label (catalog no. CS-8001).
[
1
]
[
2
]
Overview
The album debuted on
Billboard
magazine's
popular albums
chart on June 23, 1958, peaked at No. 9, and remained on that chart for 43 weeks.
[
3
]
It was his 3rd album with " 'S " in its title, and the most successful one, with the other ones peaking at No. 11 and No. 10.
AllMusic later gave the album a rating of three stars.
